_comment: Sabotage system data for Episode 10: Sabotage. Systems across Destiny fail one by one. Eli must investigate the pattern, identify the saboteur, and race against cascading failures. Repair systems while gathering evidence. Moral choice: expose the saboteur publicly vs. give a second chance privately.

scenario.title: Sabotage
scenario.description: Systems across Destiny are failing one by one — not random breakdowns, but deliberate sabotage. Eli must investigate the pattern, identify the saboteur, and stop the cascading failures before the ship goes dark.
scenario.true_motive: Danning believes Destiny's mission is a death sentence. He sabotages key systems to force an emergency return to Earth, rationalizing that the crew's survival outweighs the mission.

hydroponics_failure.description: The hydroponics air recycling system has been disabled. CO2 scrubbers in the section are offline.

power_grid_failure.description: A power grid relay in the control interface room has been short-circuited. Section power is fluctuating.

ftl_navigation_failure.description: The FTL navigation computer in the gate room has been corrupted. Destiny may drop out of FTL at the wrong coordinates.

life_support_failure.description: The life support backup system in the infirmary has been tampered with. Oxygen reserves are draining.

gate_system_failure.description: The stargate dialing computer has been sabotaged. The gate could dial an unstable address at any time.

cut_scrubber_hose.label: Cut Scrubber Hose
cut_scrubber_hose.description: The scrubber hose in hydroponics was cut with a precision tool — not torn by debris. The cut is clean and deliberate.

burned_relay.label: Burned Power Relay
burned_relay.description: The power relay was overloaded by a deliberate short-circuit. The tool marks on the casing match an engineering kit issued to the science section.

corrupted_data_chip.label: Corrupted Data Chip
corrupted_data_chip.description: A data chip inserted into the FTL navigation computer contained a virus. The code signature matches Danning's personal terminal — he wrote the corruption script.

drained_o2_tank.label: Drained Oxygen Tank
drained_o2_tank.description: The O2 backup tank valve was opened manually, venting oxygen to space. The valve handle has fingerprints from the science section — not military-issue gloves.

sabotaged_dial_crystal.label: Sabotaged Dial Crystal
sabotaged_dial_crystal.description: The stargate dial crystal was swapped with a cracked substitute. The original crystal was found in Danning's quarters, hidden under his mattress.

danning_journal.label: Danning's Personal Journal
danning_journal.description: A personal journal found in Danning's quarters. The latest entries describe his plan to force Destiny back to Earth by any means. He writes: 'The crew deserves to go home. The mission is not worth our lives.'

witness_brody.label: Brody's Testimony
witness_brody.description: Brody reports seeing Danning near the control interface room shortly before the power relay failed. Danning claimed he was checking atmospheric readings.

Danning.name: Danning
Danning.description: A scientist who has been vocal about returning to Earth. He believes the Destiny mission is a death sentence.
Danning.alibi: Claims he was in the hydroponics lab running atmospheric experiments during the first failure.
tells: Nervous when asked about the FTL computer

Volker.name: Volker
Volker.description: An engineer with access to the power grid and FTL systems. He has been frustrated with Young's leadership.
Volker.alibi: Was in the engine room during the power relay failure, confirmed by two crew members.

Park.name: Park
Park.description: A botanist who works in hydroponics. She has been stressed about food supply but has no technical access to FTL systems.
Park.alibi: Was in hydroponics tending the algae tanks when the life support was tampered with.

Brody.name: Brody
Brody.description: A technician who witnessed Danning near the control interface room. He has been a reliable crew member.
Brody.alibi: Was on the bridge during the first failure, confirmed by bridge logs.

expose.label: Expose Danning
expose.description: Publicly reveal Danning as the saboteur. The crew will know the truth, but Danning will face harsh consequences and the science faction will lose trust in command.
expose.narrative: Danning is publicly exposed and confined to quarters. The science faction is divided — some are relieved, others fear they'll be next. Young orders tighter security on all critical systems.

second_chance.label: Give a Second Chance
second_chance.description: Confront Danning privately. Give him a chance to stop the sabotage and make amends. He may reform — or he may strike again.
second_chance.narrative: Danning is confronted privately. He breaks down and admits everything. He agrees to stop and help repair the systems. The science faction stays unified, but some crew members feel justice was not served.
